scope: Offline hashes, schemas, arithmetic, raw status and cleanup audit. Audit passing does not change the native-v5 failure. Historical executable bytes are unavailable; current v5 binaries and retained source snapshots are rehashed. Native temporary WAV readback is recorded by the independent helper parser, not re-read here after deletion. Private WAVs are independently re-read locally and excluded from Git. No builds, host queries, audio or Git commands.
